method.design: single rank-64 real-OPD pilot followed by compact-SVD truncation
method.controls: same C01-S, prompts, generated completion batch, teacher logprobs, alpha/r scaling, target modules, optimizer and dtype; only learned update rank is truncated

selection.rule: smallest rank with >=99% aggregate update energy, >=95% of modules individually retaining >=95% energy, and fixed-batch teacher divergence no more than max(1%,1e-4) above rank64
